o_O thanks for reporting it!
Will fix that! Thanks

@s1monw I checked it and I need to protect all known `bin/*` files:
- elasticsearch
- elasticsearch-service-x86.exe
- plugin
- elasticsearch-service-mgr.exe
- elasticsearch.bat
- plugin.bat
- elasticsearch-service-x64.exe
- elasticsearch.in.sh
- service.bat

My first intention was to remove the support of installing plugins in `bin` dir but it sounds like we still need it.

Will send a PR probably on friday.

issue.title: bin/plugin removes itself

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
If you call `bin/plugin --remove es-plugin` the plugin got removed but the file `bin/plugin` itself was also deleted.

We now don't allow the following plugin names:
- elasticsearch
- elasticsearch-service-x86.exe
- plugin
- elasticsearch-service-mgr.exe
- elasticsearch.bat
- plugin.bat
- elasticsearch-service-x64.exe
- elasticsearch.in.sh
- service.bat

Closes #6745
